name: ca77y-library
description: Investigate questions with persisted cited evidence, or answer from an existing project-local Markdown library.

interface.shortDescription: Research with provenance; ask the existing library.
interface.longDescription: Research new sources with provenance or ask the existing library. Bounded researcher, librarian, and scribe support is optional; fresh clerks validate specs, answers, and artifacts. Bootstrap creates the Markdown library once. Dynamic model selection and one shared three-attempt stop rule support the main agent.
defaultPrompt: Research this question and save the evidence and synthesis in the library.
Answer this question using the existing library.
Bootstrap a research library in this project.
